name: Sweet Orange
source_reference: ISO 3140:2019 - Oil of sweet orange; Sawamura, 'Citrus Essential Oils', 2010
notes: Sweet orange oil is the most produced essential oil in the world, largely a byproduct of the juice industry. It oxidizes rapidly and must be stored under nitrogen.

key_markers.5989-27-5: Limonene - overwhelmingly dominant, defines sweet orange character
key_markers.112-31-2: Decanal - waxy orange-peel aldehyde, key contributor to fresh orange scent despite low percentage
key_markers.4630-07-3: Valencene - sesquiterpene marker distinguishing sweet orange from other citrus

olfactive_description: Sweet, bright, juicy orange peel with a light, fresh effervescence. Warm and friendly citrus without the sharpness of lemon or bitterness of grapefruit. Slight waxy aldehydic undertone.
